name: read_console
description: Read the most recent lines from the in-game console, oldest first, including command output, Unity errors and their stack traces. On a dedicated server (1.14.0+), the last 500 lines the game wrote to the server's own console since the mod loaded. No gateway is needed.

lines.description: Number of recent console lines to return; defaults to 40 (50 before 1.14.0).
